relocation_line: I will relocate to the Gold Coast for this role and can start three weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a civil drafter. Your advert welcomes junior and graduate designers, with mentoring from senior staff, so I wanted to apply.

During the course I prepared civil drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage. Before that, on building sites in the Philippines, I reviewed drawings and checked the work against the plans.

I'd move to the Gold Coast and can start three weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
